answer: Account-age escrow: each new wallet must lock 30 POA for 12 epochs before its votes count, and the lock doubles for every extra wallet sharing a cipher-signed device attestation. 1,000 clones would need 30 POA each plus doubling, which no dune of cheap wallets survives. Anyone can check locks on-chain, and a random 8% audit slashes the escrow of a flagged relic wallet. Honest users lock 30 POA once.
